The *Saṁvarakathā* ("Discourse on Restraint") is an Abhidhamma debate belonging to the third chapter (*vagga*) of the *Kathāvatthu* (Kv 3.10) in the Pali Canon [SuttaCentral]. SuttaCentral records one modern translation for this text [SuttaCentral]. None of the available reference passages from secondary literature discuss this specific debate; all retrieved citations for *saṁvara* instead treat unrelated subjects such as the Tantric *Cakrasaṃvara* literature, Candragomin’s *Bodhisattva-saṃvara-viṃśikā*, monastic vinaya rules, or Jain ethical formulas.

Text reuse is further observed with the *Pañcakanipāta* (AN 5), *Aṭṭhakanipāta* (AN 8), *Catukkapuggalapaññatti* (Pp 2.4), and the *Abhidhammamātikāpāḷi* [DharmaNexus].
